scope: A4.0(c) finite-H Mermin entropy unit oracle
A4.1 test-hook W2 matrix and hubbard_u_pot insertion unit coverage

entropy_oracle.states: eight explicit states: four bands over two k points; rows 1-2 spin up, rows 3-4 spin down
entropy_oracle.formula: S=-sum_k w_k sum_n[f_nk ln(f_nk)+(1-f_nk)ln(1-f_nk)]; TS=kB*T*S; f=1/(1+exp((epsilon-mu)/kT))
entropy_oracle.spin_convention: sum all explicit spin-band rows once; no extra spin degeneracy
entropy_oracle.bound_model: 256*epsilon_machine*sum(abs(w_k*h(f_nk))) for S and kB*T times that bound for TS; diagonal finite-H fixture has exact analytic eigenvalues and no diagonalizer residual
entropy_oracle.endpoint_rule: f=0 and f=1 entropy terms are exactly zero; production Fermi cutoff convention is exercised at arguments +/-100
entropy_oracle.production_reporting_rule: TS and F=E-TS appear beside each available total KS candidate; global TS is not decomposed by site; RS/N/A entropy is explicitly unavailable, not zero

w2_operator_oracle.basis: spherical onsite d basis m=-2,-1,0,+1,+2, extracted indices 5:9
w2_operator_oracle.expected_insertion: lambda*W2 in each spin's onsite 5x5 d block of hubbard_u_pot; all non-d and cross-spin blocks zero; when fixed U is inactive the insertion replaces stale carrier content
w2_operator_oracle.comparison: exact binary64 equality: W2 entries and lambda=0.25 are exactly representable; the test verifies exact Hermiticity, exact same-spin d-block insertion, and exact zero in all untouched/cross-spin blocks
